newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur confident about future profits.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur confident about future profits.

text.p: Peter Spaelti, chairman and chief executive of Winterthur Insurance Co . said on Tuesday he expects the insurer to continually improve profits and return on investment (ROI) in future years.
Spaelti, however, declined to put a figure on his profit expectations, in comparison with an average profit rise of 19.6 percent since 1992.
"I assume we will be very successful in the next years and periodically show substantial profit rises," Spaelti told a news conference, adding:
"We will continuously increase profits in the next years and continually raise the return on investments."
"That is our aim and we believe in this," he added.
